$comment: Contrarian example. Kept out of profiles/index.json on purpose: free, 1M context, and widely used, but its provider is permitted to train on your prompts and it has no `max` effort. `oc-harness list` shows it struck through with the reason. Install it with `oc-harness use muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free` and the warning is repeated on install.
title: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor Free (OpenCode Zen)
notes: Capability/privacy tradeoff, not a recommendation. Served over /v1/responses, a better cache dialect than chat/completions, and it supports temperature. But: 'Heavily discounted token pricing in exchange for permission to use your prompts and completions to train future Meta models', and its top effort is xhigh rather than max. Do not make this the default for private code.
